secondary.description: Warm Clay - Represents the hearth, warmth, and creativity.

layout_strategies.spacing: Relaxed. Use p-6, p-8, gap-6, gap-8. Avoid tight clusters.

grids.masonry: Use CSS columns or masonry grid for chore/task lists to feel organic like sticky notes.

layout_strategies.containers: Max-width 1200px for dashboards, 800px for reading/content centered.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlay on backgrounds (opacity 0.03) to simulate paper.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide React (rounded style) or Phosphor Icons (Duotone) for a softer look.
visual_enhancers.decorations: Use abstract organic shapes (blobs, waves) in the background with low opacity (accent colors).

child_creative.usage: Children's dashboard header or creative section

modifications: Increase default padding in Cards and Dialogs
Use Nunito for all UI text in components
Remove sharp corners from inputs and selects (make them rounded-xl)

Navigation.style: Floating sidebar or top pill-nav. Do not use full-width rigid dark sidebars.

Forms.input_style: bg-white border-2 border-transparent focus:border-secondary/50 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-secondary/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 shadow-sm transition-all placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure Tailwind theme to match the palette exactly.
Create a 'NoiseOverlay' component that adds a fixed grain texture to the body.
Use the 'kids_mode' palette when the user role is 'child'.
Avoid pure black (#000000). Use the dark forest green (#2D4F3F) or dark charcoal (#2A2A2A) for text.
Ensure all buttons have the 'bouncy' interaction (scale down slightly on click).
For the 'Weekly Planner', use a horizontal scrollable card list for mobile, and a grid for desktop.
Implement a toggle for 'Parent View' vs 'Child View' in development to easily test both personas.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
